name: Project Sex Shuudan Ninshin ~Athlete o Haramasero!~
original_name: プロジェクトSEX 集団妊娠～アスリートを孕ませろ！～
source: In this country of this era, the party's power is absolute and no one can go against it. Those who disagreed would be lost in less than a month. On the contrary, for those who have pledged to the party and who are fond of the party leaders, they receive various preferential treatment from the country. In this poor country, in order to complete Tenju, we have to swear the party's allegiance and absolutely obey the order from the party. Any unreasonable order can only be obeyed. There is no freedom at all, and the unintended pregnancy forcing in a desperate situation is the theme of this work.
translation: 在这个时代的这个国家，党的权力是绝对的，没有人能违抗。持不同意见的人不到一个月就会消失。相反，那些向党宣誓效忠并受到党领袖青睐的人，则会得到国家的各种优待。在这个贫穷的国家，为了完成天授的使命，人们必须宣誓效忠党并绝对服从党的命令。任何不合理的命令都只能服从。这里没有任何自由，而在绝境中被迫怀孕便是本作的主题。
